fields.climate: transitional, between maritime and continental; wet, moderate winters and summers
fields.terrain: lowland, many scattered small lakes, fertile soil
fields.farm: wheat, milk, sugar beets, rapeseed, barley, potatoes, triticale, oats, beans, peas
fields.exports: refined petroleum, furniture, plastic products, wheat, cars
fields.industries: metal-cutting machine tools, electric motors, televisions, refrigerators and freezers, petroleum refining, shipbuilding (small ships), furniture, textiles, food processing, fertilizer, agricultural…
fields.languages: Lithuanian (official) 85.3%, Russian 6.8%, Polish 5.1%, other 1.1%, two mother tongues 1.7%
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 74.2%, Russian Orthodox 3.7%, Old Believer 0.6%, Evangelical Lutheran 0.6%, Evangelical Reformist 0.2%, other (including Sunni Muslim, Jewish, Greek Catholic, and Karaite) 0.9%, none…
fields.legal: civil law system; legislative acts can be appealed to the Constitutional Court
fields.military: 19-26 years of age for conscripted military service for men; 9-month service obligation;  18-38 for voluntary service for men and women; 18-60 for the National Defense Volunteer Services
